title: MLINESTYLE DXF OBJECTS writer allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated full-file ASCII/Binary AC1027 MLINESTYLE transaction and same-library readback only; no producer or support claim.

implementation.path: Public DXF OBJECTS callback in a complete dxfRW::write operation
implementation.profile: Two parallel lines, built-in BYLAYER/BYBLOCK indices, scalar/color fields, and two EED values

assertions: Each injected allocation failure returns a failed write and preserves pre-existing destination bytes.
The source DRW_MLineStyle fields, element values, and EED remain unchanged after failure.
Retry with the same writer and source object succeeds and produces byte-identical output to a clean write.
Fresh typed libdxfrw readback verifies the emitted style, built-in linetype resolution, and EED for ASCII and Binary DXF.

validation.observed_allocation_counts: ASCII 21; Binary 19 in both normal and ASan executables

limitations: Generated controls establish transaction behavior and same-library readback only.
Producer coverage, source graph closure, native consumer behavior, and broader support remain unqualified.
DXF files are generated from scratch in a temporary directory and removed by the test; no DWG or DXF fixture was added.
